lines.zh: 这身绒毛湿透了，走起来沉。
lines.en: This fleece is soaked through and heavy to walk in.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边快跑，蹄子打滑。
lines.en: I jog the shoreline and my hooves slip.
Seaweed tangles in my wool and will not shake loose.

lines.zh: 我低头走，鼻子里全是咸味。
lines.en: Head down, I walk and my nose fills with salt.
These four legs run better than they used to.

lines.zh: 我踩着湿沙，留下一串印。
lines.en: I cross wet sand and leave a line of prints.

lines.zh: 我绕开那些礁石，往里走。
lines.en: I round the rocks and head inland.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我去舔那些石缝。
lines.en: The tide is out; I go lick the rock seams.
Walking, I shake the water off.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，像在赶什么。
lines.en: I walk fast, as if chasing something.
My hooves knock a dull sound on stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着村子边缘走了一圈。
lines.en: I skirt the village edge in a wide loop.
Salt has crusted white on my fleece.

lines.zh: 我停下听了一会儿，又走了。
lines.en: I stop to listen, then walk on.

lines.zh: 这条上岸的路，我走过很多次。
lines.en: I've walked this landing path many times.
I tread across a mat of kelp.
I stand still and my wool drips.

lines.zh: 咸风把我的毛吹得乱翘。
lines.en: The salt wind ruffs my wool up.
I chew the single strand of grass in my mouth.

lines.zh: 那几个村民在看我，我不动。
lines.en: Those villagers are watching. I do not move.
I shake my head and droplets fly.

lines.zh: 这具身体好像不再需要睡。
lines.en: This body seems to no longer need sleep.

lines.zh: 我盯着海面，那里有东西在动。
lines.en: I stare at the sea. Something moves there.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的蹄子，变了形。
lines.en: I look down at my hooves. They have changed.
More teeth than before, and sharper.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，闻到铁的味道。
lines.en: I stand and smell iron in the air.
Something is crawling in my fleece.

lines.zh: 我嚼了一下，什么也没吃到。
lines.en: I chew and get nothing.
Shouting far off; I turn my head.

lines.zh: 我把背靠着礁石，蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I lean against a rock and rub my back on it.

lines.zh: 你袖口有羊毛，混着铁锈。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of wool and rust.
Do not put a hand in my wool.
Step back. I bite.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是给谁看的。
lines.en: This body is not for anyone to look at.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛里长着深海的腕足。
lines.en: Deep-sea tendrils grow in my fleece.

lines.zh: 你一吸气，肚子就露出来。
lines.en: Each breath exposes your belly.

lines.zh: 我闻到羊毛以外的味道。
lines.en: I smell something other than wool on you.

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西，能割开我吗。
lines.en: Can that thing in your hand cut me open?

lines.zh: 我不再是那只安静的羊。
lines.en: I am no longer that quiet sheep.
You want to drive me back to the pen? Try.
My fleece is cut open to the flesh.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，血混进海水。
lines.en: I step back as blood mixes with seawater.
This body still feels pain. Strange.
I lower my head to guard my throat.
He cut deep. I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我的腿抖了一下，又稳住。
lines.en: One leg shakes, then steadies.
Blood creeps down through my wool.
I shake my head and blood flies off.
I will remember that blow.
I retreat to the water, ready again.
That is not grass. I do not eat it.
I smell salt, closer than food.
That grass in your hand. Let me see.
I take a bite and it tastes wrong.
Once I would have followed that.

lines.zh: 我现在饿的东西，你给不了。
lines.en: What I hunger for now, you cannot give.
That smell takes me back to the pen.
I spit the grass out. Too dry.
Step back and let me smell it first.
Food will not change me back.
You bumped me and now you are wet.
Not so close. I kick.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头，比看着重。
lines.en: These bones weigh more than they look.
You scuffed my hoofprints.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛吸了海水，很沉。
lines.en: My fleece soaked up seawater. Heavy.

lines.zh: 海水把我们都推了一下。
lines.en: The water pushed us both.
Back off. I do not like being crowded.
That is not worth turning around for.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在我毛上留了印。
lines.en: Your boot left a mark in my fleece.
Move. I am heading to the sea.

lines.zh: 羊群里还有几只，也变了。
lines.en: There are others in the flock. They changed too.
They do not know me anymore.

lines.zh: 这种身体，还能生出什么。
lines.en: What could this body even bring forth?

lines.zh: 我记得从前的伴侣，只剩气味。
lines.en: I remember my old mate. Only the smell is left.
We stand together in the shallows.
Neither of us bleats now.
Seaweed tangles its fleece too.

lines.zh: 我们并肩看海，什么也不说。
lines.en: We watch the sea side by side in silence.

lines.zh: 这不算温柔，只是没散开。
lines.en: It is not tenderness. We simply have not parted.
I lick the salt off its fleece.
I chew this kelp twice.
I pick up a shell in my teeth.
That rope is still usable.
There is a bone by my hoof.
I lower my head for a scrap of meat.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着东西，我往前走。
lines.en: Something in my mouth, I walk on.
A scrap of cloth has caught in my wool.

lines.zh: 我把东西吐出来看了看。
lines.en: I spit it out and look at it.
A shard of iron. I keep it.
I swallow it. No taste.
Someone over there has iron.
My nose found him first.
His back is to me. Good position.

lines.zh: 这具身体知道该怎么做。
lines.en: This body knows what to do.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨了两下，我认准他。
lines.en: Two scrapes of my hoof and I fix on him.
He has not heard my hooves yet.
The target is near the tideline.
I have his footwork.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡不会自己走过来。
lines.en: An iron golem will not walk over on its own.

lines.zh: 我贴地挪过去，不发出声音。
lines.en: I slide along the ground without a sound.
I circle him without hurrying.
Hooves on sand make little sound.
He is trying to place me.

lines.zh: 我一直低着头，藏住眼睛。
lines.en: Head low, I keep my eyes hidden.

lines.zh: 潮水在帮我把声音盖住。
lines.en: The surf covers my noise.
He has backed to the rocks.
Close enough after that circle.

lines.zh: 我这身绒毛，已经长出鳃。
lines.en: My fleece has grown gills.

lines.zh: 他摸向腰间，我伏低身子。
lines.en: He reaches for his belt; I lower myself.
I stop and let him relax.
Head down, I ram his stomach.
My hoof catches his shin.

lines.zh: 我咬住他的袖子，往后拽。
lines.en: I bite his sleeve and drag him back.
The charge throws him into the sand.
My teeth come together with a crack.
I drive my skull into his chest.

lines.zh: 他躲开第一次，第二次没躲过。
lines.en: He dodged the first, not the second.
I pin him under me.

lines.zh: 毛上的水全甩到他脸上。
lines.en: The water off my fleece hits his face.
My hit rolls him half a turn.

lines.zh: 湿毛贴着肋骨，我上了岸。
lines.en: Wet fleece clings to my ribs as I come ashore.

lines.zh: 湿毛贴在身上，我走上海滩。
lines.en: Wet wool plastered to me, I walk up the beach.

lines.zh: 这具身体，是我，也不全是我。
lines.en: This body is me, and not entirely me.
My hooves touch sand for the first time.
I shake and seawater scatters.
I look up and see lights ashore.
There is one more of me on this flat.
I chew the kelp in my mouth.
My fleece is still dripping.
The wind comes off the sea. I stand firm.
The fire curled my fleece.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上滑下，摔得闷。
lines.en: I slid off the rocks and landed hard.
The tide holds me under and I struggle.
The blast threw me into the surf.
An arrow is buried in my fleece.
Odd light burns inside my wool.
There is nothing to eat on this flat.

lines.zh: 雷落在滩上，我浑身僵了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the flat and I seized up.

lines.zh: 海水变成黑色，我一直往下沉。
lines.en: The sea went black and I keep sinking.
